BGM_MASTER.RandomPending: A track will be picked at random when it starts
BGM_MASTER.TogglePlaylistFavorite: Toggle favorite for the current playlist
BGM_MASTER.SelectHint: Select a playlist and track to play.
BGM_MASTER.ChatSound.PlaylistHint: Plays a random sound from this playlist whenever a chat message arrives (type the playlist name; empty = off). Replaces the Bing Bong! module — while Bing Bong! is enabled this stays silent to avoid double sounds.
BGM_MASTER.ChatSound.RollPlaylistHint: Playlist to play for dice roll messages (empty = off; the dice sound still plays).
BGM_MASTER.ChatSound.EnabledHint: Whether this browser plays the chat notification sound (each player can turn it off).
